summary.zh: 用向量库与语义检索搭建知识增强问答
summary.en: Build knowledge-grounded Q&A over vector search

description.zh: 讲解检索增强生成的整体搭建流程，涵盖文档切分、向量化、检索与生成各环节的组合方式。适合做文档问答、接入企业知识库或让模型结合外部资料回答。需要自备向量数据库与 embedding 模型。
description.en: Walks through building retrieval-augmented generation end to end, from chunking and embeddings to retrieval and generation. Suits document Q&A and knowledge-base grounding. Requires a vector database and an embedding model.
